subject: Compact evaluation plan and request to accelerate close
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Susan Park <susan@vectorhealth.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compact evaluation plan + ask to accelerate close

Hi Susan —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Based on the MAP we've been iterating, I want to propose a condensed evaluation that reduces your runway from 6 weeks to a targeted 2-week pilot so you can keep the Q2 budget window. High-level suggestion below (full MAP attached):

- Week 0 (prep): SOC2 evidence checkpoint + sandbox account ready (you own: security/compliance)
- Week 1 (pilot): Three scoped tests (API perf & latency, integration with EMR export, a short QA of hallucination/critical prompts)
- Week 2 (validation): Acceptance checklist, token-cost burn report, rollback plan

Risks to call out: SOC2 evidence delays, procurement PO timing, and internal evaluation bandwidth. If Vector Health can commit to the prep items by 2025-05-29 we can start the pilot on 2025-06-02 and aim for a close by 2025-06-16.

I'm attaching the VectorHealth_MAP_v2.pdf and a SOC2_evidence_checklist.xlsx to make the prep work easier. If Procurement needs a formal SOW or a short statement of work, loop them in and I’ll get a draft over today.

Ask: Please confirm by EOD whether the evaluation team can complete the SOC2 checklist and sandbox provisioning by 2025-05-29. If yes, I will request an acceleration credit approval from Rafael to help keep your cost exposure low during the pilot.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
From: Susan Park <susan@vectorhealth.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@vectorhealth.io>
Date: Thu, 22 May 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compact evaluation plan + ask to accelerate close

Aditya —

Thanks for the clear plan. The evaluation team is aligned on scope, but we hit a snag: our security lead needs additional SOC2 artifacts (encryption-at-rest keys + recent pen test summary) before we can provision the sandbox. Procurement also flagged our internal PO cycle that won't clear until mid-June unless we agree a shorter-term MSA addendum.

Two asks from our side: 1) Can Redwood provide a one-page summary of the pen test scope and encryption controls (we can accept a redacted view)? 2) Is there flexibility on a short-term pilot pricing/credit while our PO clears? If both are workable we can target the prep completion by 2025-05-30 (slightly later than your ask).

Susan Park
Director, Clinical Integrations — Vector Health
susan@vectorhealth.io

---
Attachments: none in this reply
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Susan Park <susan@vectorhealth.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 May 2025 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compact evaluation plan + ask to accelerate close

Susan —

Totally understand. Quick responses and an adjusted proposal:

1) Security artifacts: I can send a one-page redacted pen test summary and an encryption controls overview by 17:00 PT today. I’ll also include a short note from our security lead on key rotation and KMS integration.

2) Pricing/credit: Rafael, can we offer a $5,000 pilot credit (applied to first invoice) conditional on Vector Health signing the MAP addendum and starting pilot by 2025-06-02? The credit is to limit your cost while procurement completes the PO.

Revised timeline (gives you the extra day for SOC2 artifacts):
- 2025-05-30: SOC2 checklist + sandbox provisioning confirmation (Vector owner: Susan/security)
- 2025-06-02 to 2025-06-13: Compact pilot (Redwood will provide focused test plan + runbook)
- 2025-06-16: Close decision meeting (accept/reject)

I'll attach an updated MAP link in HubSpot and a short SOW template if Procurement wants it. If this works, please reply with OK to the revised dates and Procurement can confirm next steps.

Thanks — I’m happy to jump on a short call today if helpful.

Aditya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: VectorHealth_MAP_v2.pdf, SOC2_evidence_checklist.xlsx
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Susan Park <susan@vectorhealth.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 May 2025 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compact evaluation plan + ask to accelerate close

Aditya / Susan —

I approve a $5,000 pilot credit on the conditions Aditya outlined: pilot must begin by 2025-06-02 and Vector Health signs the attached MAP addendum (linked in HubSpot). If you can confirm those two items by EOD tomorrow I’ll get the credit processed.

One-line confirmation from Vector and we'll move forward.

Rafael Mendes
Sales Director, Redwood Inference
rafeal@redwood.com

---
(Quick note: I’ll need Marissa to own onboarding coordination and to confirm the runbook is locked.)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Susan Park <susan@vectorhealth.io>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 May 2025 16:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compact evaluation plan + ask to accelerate close

Susan / Aditya —

Happy to own onboarding and the pilot runbook. I’ll share the onboarding_runbook.pdf with step-by-step sandbox instructions and the test harness by tomorrow morning. From our side, CS can staff two engineers on call during the pilot window (2025-06-02 through 2025-06-13).

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: onboarding_runbook.pdf
